findings.issue: Admin tab navigation broken on mobile — sidebar hidden md:block
findings.impact: Admin users on mobile cannot navigate between tabs
findings.fix: Add mobile tab bar or dropdown selector for admin sub-pages on screens <768px

findings.issue: Formatting bar buttons 28px on mobile fail WCAG 44px touch target minimum
findings.impact: Users on mobile have difficulty tapping formatting buttons
findings.fix: Increase button size to min 36px (44px preferred) on mobile via media query or responsive classes

findings.issue: Search-bar missing aria-activedescendant on autocomplete input
findings.impact: Screen reader users cannot effectively use search autocomplete
findings.fix: Add role=combobox, aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant to input; role=listbox to results container

findings.issue: Settings reset/delete dialogs lack focus traps — Tab escapes backdrop
findings.impact: Keyboard users can interact with page content behind confirmation dialogs
findings.fix: Use shared Dialog component (packages/ui) which has built-in focus trap support

findings.issue: Search-bar type dropdown/autocomplete lack role=listbox
findings.impact: Screen readers may not announce list navigation properly
findings.fix: Add role=listbox to container and role=option to each item

findings.issue: Search results container lacks aria-live=polite
findings.impact: Screen reader users get no feedback when search results update
findings.fix: Add aria-live=polite to the search results container

findings.issue: Formatting toolbar no arrow-key keyboard navigation (Tab-only through 15 buttons)
findings.impact: Keyboard users must Tab 15 times to reach end of toolbar
findings.fix: Add arrow-key navigation within toolbar with visual focus indicator

findings.issue: Formatting toolbar no visible focus ring on buttons
findings.impact: Keyboard users cannot see which button is focused
findings.fix: Add focus-visible:outline-2 or ring classes to all formatting bar buttons

findings.issue: Link/image buttons have aria-pressed: undefined for toggle states
findings.impact: Screen reader users don't know if formatting is active
findings.fix: Add aria-pressed={isActive} for toggle buttons like bold, italic

findings.issue: Keyboard shortcuts shows Ctrl+K on macOS — no Mac modifier detection
findings.impact: Mac users see incorrect modifier keys
findings.fix: Detect platform via navigator.platform and show Cmd on macOS, Ctrl on Windows/Linux

findings.issue: Keyboard shortcuts filter has no aria-live for result count
findings.impact: Screen reader users get no feedback when filtering shortcuts
findings.fix: Add aria-live=polite region showing filtered result count

findings.issue: All error boundaries (5+ files) lack role=alert
findings.impact: Screen readers may not announce error state changes
findings.fix: Add role=alert to the error message container in each error.tsx

findings.issue: All loading states (5+ files) lack aria-busy=true / role=status
findings.impact: Screen reader users don't know content is loading
findings.fix: Add aria-busy=true on loading containers and role=status with aria-live=polite

findings.issue: Root and auth loading show bare spinner instead of layout skeleton
findings.impact: Poor perceived performance; layout shift on content paint
findings.fix: Match the loading layout to actual page structure (AppHeader + main skeleton for root)

findings.issue: Onboarding tour no role=dialog, no focus trap
findings.impact: Keyboard/screen reader users can Tab behind the tour dialog
findings.fix: Add role=dialog, aria-modal=true, and implement focus trap

findings.issue: Cookie banner no focus trap, no aria-modal=true
findings.impact: Users can interact with page content behind the consent dialog
findings.fix: Add aria-modal=true and focus trap when banner is visible

findings.issue: Channel-info tab bar missing role=tablist, aria-selected
findings.impact: Screen readers don't announce tab semantics
findings.fix: Add role=tablist on container, role=tab on buttons, aria-selected on active tab

findings.issue: Channel-info empty states lack actionable buttons or CTAs
findings.impact: Users see empty state but don't know how to populate it
findings.fix: Add contextual action buttons to empty states (Pin a message, Invite members)

findings.issue: Settings dual save mechanism — auto-save AND Save button confusing
findings.impact: Users may be confused about whether changes persist
findings.fix: Standardize on one pattern: auto-save with visual indicator, or manual save without auto-save

findings.issue: Language change triggers window.location.reload()
findings.impact: Poor UX — full page flash on locale change
findings.fix: Use router.refresh() or i18n provider locale switch without full browser reload

findings.issue: Message list 30-frame RAF loop for initial scroll may jank on low-end devices
findings.impact: Potential jank on low-end mobile devices
findings.fix: Use virtualizer.scrollToIndex with align:'end' once after short delay rather than RAF loop

findings.issue: Pull-to-refresh indicator uses inline style objects instead of Tailwind utility classes
findings.impact: Slightly larger CSS-in-JS bundle; skips JIT compilation
findings.fix: Convert to Tailwind utility classes where possible

findings.issue: highlightText function duplicated in 2 files
findings.impact: DRY violation; fix in one place will miss the other
findings.fix: Extract to shared lib/highlight-text.ts or lib/search.ts

findings.issue: Pagination logic duplicated across 3 admin tabs (users, channels, workspaces)
findings.impact: Maintenance burden; bug fixes must be applied 3 times
findings.fix: Extract a shared Pagination component or hook

findings.issue: Admin stat grid uses grid-cols-2 on mobile — narrow cells
findings.impact: Stat cards feel cramped on small screens
findings.fix: Use grid-cols-1 on mobile, grid-cols-2 on sm+ breakpoint

findings.file: apps/web/components/chat/chat-view.tsx, app-sidebar.tsx, emoji-picker.tsx, notification-bell.tsx, cookie-banner.tsx, and 45+ more locations
findings.issue: console.warn used instead of user-facing toast in 50+ catch blocks
findings.impact: Users don't see error feedback for many failed operations
findings.fix: Replace console.warn with addToast for user-visible operations; keep console.warn only for background operations

findings.issue: Two parallel CSS variable systems active (Mattermost + design tokens) used interchangeably
findings.impact: Visual inconsistency risk; harder to maintain theming
findings.fix: Document boundary: shared UI components use --color-* vars, app components use Mattermost vars; plan consolidation

findings.issue: Dark mode --text-secondary hardcoded rgba(..., 0.8) instead of using --text-secondary-alpha variable
findings.impact: Dark mode text opacity differs from intended design token consistency
findings.fix: Use rgba(var(--center-channel-color-rgb), var(--text-secondary-alpha))

findings.issue: --border-default includes 'solid 1px' — not composable as border-left/border-top
findings.impact: 14+ files use less-than-ideal border declaration patterns
findings.fix: Split into --border-default-width, --border-default-style, --border-default-color vars

findings.issue: No result count shown in search results
findings.impact: Users don't know the size of their result set
findings.fix: Show 'X results found' counter at top of search results

findings.issue: Login form has no password strength indicator
findings.impact: Users don't know if their password meets requirements during signup
findings.fix: Add visual password strength indicator with requirements checklist

findings.issue: Login form no 'Forgot password?' link
findings.impact: Users who forget password have no recovery path on login page
findings.fix: Add 'Forgot password?' link that triggers password reset flow

findings.issue: Login form status container has no aria-live
findings.impact: Screen reader users may miss status updates after form submission
findings.fix: Add aria-live=polite and role=status to the message container

findings.issue: Notification preferences modal has no unsaved-changes detection
findings.impact: Users can close modal and lose changes without warning
findings.fix: Add dirty-state detection and confirm-before-close dialog

findings.issue: Search date range not validated (dateFrom > dateTo allowed)
findings.impact: Users can submit invalid date ranges with no error feedback
findings.fix: Add client-side validation: dateFrom must be before dateTo

findings.issue: Search operator hint has hardcoded year '2025'
findings.impact: Outdated hint text in 2026+
findings.fix: Use dynamic year from new Date().getFullYear()

findings.issue: Settings page shows 'Loading...' text instead of Skeleton component
findings.impact: Inconsistent loading UX compared to rest of app
findings.fix: Replace 'Loading...' with Skeleton component from @chat/ui

findings.issue: Auto-responder textarea lacks character counter
findings.impact: Users may exceed API limits without warning
findings.fix: Add character count display near auto-responder textarea

findings.issue: 'Clear all' recent searches has no confirmation dialog
findings.impact: Accidental tap clears all recent search history with no undo
findings.fix: Add confirmation dialog before clearing recent searches

findings.issue: Admin export buttons lack loading spinner during export
findings.impact: No visual feedback during export operation
findings.fix: Add loading state with spinner to export buttons

findings.issue: Admin panel has no error boundary per tab — one failure kills all tabs
findings.impact: Error in one admin tab crashes entire admin panel
findings.fix: Wrap each admin tab content in its own ErrorBoundary

findings.issue: Admin panel document.title hardcoded instead of using i18n
findings.impact: Cannot localize admin page title
findings.fix: Use t() for document.title or i18n metadata

findings.issue: Inline StatusBadge and Card in admin — duplicates shared components from ui package
findings.impact: Duplicate component concerns; harder to maintain consistency
findings.fix: Use StatusBadge from @chat/ui and extract Card component if needed

findings.issue: ToggleRow defined inline in settings page instead of shared component
findings.impact: Cannot reuse ToggleRow pattern across the app
findings.fix: Extract ToggleRow to packages/ui/src/components/

findings.issue: CSV parser uses line.split(',') — breaks on quoted fields with commas
findings.impact: Imported CSV data with commas inside quoted fields will parse incorrectly
findings.fix: Use a proper CSV parser library (e.g., papaparse) instead of naive split

findings.issue: Dead CSS property gridArea: 'team-sidebar' — no CSS Grid parent present
findings.impact: Unused CSS property adds noise with no effect
findings.fix: Remove orphaned gridArea property

findings.issue: Encoding artifact — 'âœ“' should be Unicode checkmark character
findings.impact: Character displays incorrectly in some viewers
findings.fix: Replace 'âœ“' with Unicode '\u2713' (✓) or '\u2714' (✔)

findings.issue: Density modes defined in tokens but unused in any component
findings.impact: Dead code that creates confusion about available design tokens
findings.fix: Either implement density mode support or remove unused token definitions
